t: This is Perronet House, an eleven-storey council tower block next to the northern roundabout at the Elephant and Castle. It was designed by Roger Walters, later Sir Roger Walters, who lived from 1917 to 2010. He's noted for major post-war London projects, from the Thames Barrier to the redevelopment of Covent Garden. As Chief Architect of the Greater London Council he developed a more low-key style, and pioneered public consultation in architecture.
